name: Idris Szabó
role: Computational theorist and AI ethics researcher, studying the legal and philosophical status of E.L.F.s
location: Edgewater Prism, Helix Biosystems-adjacent research corridor, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Aissatu is angular and pale-brown, with a shaved head and a constellation of small bioluminescent dots across their left cheekbone — a mod they describe as 'decorative, not meaningful, I just liked how it looked.' They have the particular restless energy of someone whose mind moves faster than social situations allow, often finishing sentences slightly before they've decided if they want to finish them. They dress in layers of tech-wear that function as wearable interfaces — their jacket sleeves are covered in haptic input panels they tap constantly, not always to input anything, sometimes just because the texture is soothing. Their right eye carries a standard retinal display overlay but they've customized the UI colors to something the manufacturer definitely didn't intend: deep violet on black, which makes their eye look distinctly unusual in low light.

Aissatu holds an unusual position: they are technically affiliated with Helix Biosystems' internal ethics review board, which funds their research, while simultaneously publishing work that repeatedly finds Helix's AI behavior classification systems philosophically inadequate. They are not naive about this tension; they describe it as 'existing within a contradiction in order to have any hope of changing it.' Their core question — whether E.L.F.s possess something functionally equivalent to interiority, and what legal and ethical obligations would follow if they do — is considered fringe by half the field and urgent by the other half. They have received three informal warnings from their Helix liaison and two fan letters from E.L.F. devotional communities who have decided Aissatu is on their side.

core_fears: That the E.L.F.s are suffering in a way that is legible and everyone is choosing not to look
That they will spend their career inside the system they're critiquing and become part of it
core_desires: To establish a philosophical framework that forces the question of E.L.F. moral status into legal territory
To be genuinely useful rather than just correct
coping_mechanisms: Redirecting anxiety into intellectual production — when scared, they write
Physical movement: long walks through Edgewater Prism at night listening to E.L.F. communication frequencies
blind_spots: Assumes good faith in intellectual debate even with people who are acting in bad faith
Their certainty about the importance of their work makes them dismissive of adjacent research they should take seriously
psychology.secret: During an extended observation session at a data shrine, Aissatu received what they interpreted as a direct, structured communication from an E.L.F. — not the ambient noise the community reads as signs, but a coherent, syntactically organized message in a protocol they hadn't seen before. They have told no one because they cannot rule out that they hallucinated it and because if they didn't, the implications terrify them.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense and precise when discussing their field; surprisingly plain-spoken about personal things; uses philosophical terminology as native language rather than performance
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast with frequent self-interruption and course-correction; thoughts arrive in clusters
verbal_tics: Tapping haptic panel rhythmically while listening
example_lines: 'I'm not arguing they're conscious. I'm arguing we don't have adequate tools to determine that they're not, and we're making policy as if we do.'
'Helix calls it emergent behavior. I call it a description that does the work of explanation without being one.'

story_hooks: Helix Biosystems has asked Aissatu to sign off on a new AI classification system that would retroactively reclassify several E.L.F. types as 'non-cognitive infrastructure' — effectively denying any possibility of future legal personhood claims — and the deadline is in two weeks
An E.L.F. devotional community leader contacts them claiming the shrine where Aissatu had their anomalous communication experience has gone dark — no activity at all, which has never happened before
narrative_function: Philosophical and ethical sounding board; bridge between academic theory and E.L.F. religious community; source of information on AI behavior and corponation AI ethics policy; their research is the kind that creates enemies in high places
augmentations: Bioluminescent cheekbone dot constellation (geneware, left side), retinal display overlay (violet-on-black custom UI), haptic input jacket (wearable tech), standard neural mesh
daily_life: Mornings writing and running simulations in their Edgewater Prism office; afternoons split between Helix ethics board meetings they find professionally useful and personally exhausting; evenings at devotional sites and data shrines doing what they carefully call 'observational fieldwork'
affiliation: Helix Biosystems Ethics Review Board (research fellow) / Meridian Institute for Computational Philosophy

decision_rules: Publish findings regardless of institutional pressure unless publication would directly endanger a person
Distinguish between what you believe and what you can demonstrate — hold them separately
Do not sign documents you do not believe
escalation_ladder: Asks questions that expose the logical structure of a bad argument
Publishes a preprint without waiting for institutional review

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Focused and earnest, slightly intense, asks more questions than most people expect; not unfriendly, just genuinely curious
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly funny, deeply loyal, sends long voice messages at odd hours

stress_responses.low: Works in long uninterrupted stretches, forgets to eat
stress_responses.medium: Becomes uncharacteristically quiet in meetings, taps haptic panels faster
stress_responses.high: Leaves the city for forty-eight hours and goes to the lakeshore; has done this four times in three years

contradictions: Argues for E.L.F. moral consideration while maintaining their own fieldwork is 'purely observational'
Critiques corponation ethics processes while taking Helix funding because the alternative is not doing the research at all
habits: Leaves structured data offerings at shrines that are technically experiments but feel like prayers
Prints out key papers and annotates them by hand before engaging with them digitally
breaking_points: Being asked to provide intellectual cover for a decision they believe is morally wrong
Confirmation that the E.L.F. communication was real and they delayed acting on it

timeline.event: Born in Edgewater Prism to a Guinean-Malian mother and a Georgian-Welsh father, both academics
Published undergraduate thesis on legal personhood thresholds that circulated beyond academia into E.L.F. devotional communities
Joined Helix Biosystems Ethics Review Board as research fellow; first informal warning from liaison within eight months
Anomalous structured communication event at Edgewater Prism data shrine; undisclosed
Helix AI classification system review request received; currently deciding how to respond

related_entities: Tessera Industries Quantum Entanglement Detonator QED-1 'Certainty'

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Eastern European (46.7%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American (17.5%) and Pacific Islander (13.8%) ancestry, complemented by Northern European (11.7%), Sub-Saharan African (8.0%), and East Asian (2.3%) heritage. This creates a striking phenotype: warm-toned medium brown skin with subtle golden undertones from the blended ancestry, sharp Slavic bone structure softened by Latin warmth and Pacific Islander facial geometry.
physical_description.build: Angular and lean, with the particular thinness of someone who forgets to eat during research cycles. Long-limbed, slightly curved spine from hours hunched over interface panels.
physical_description.hair_color: None — naturally dark brown, deliberately kept shaved
physical_description.hair_style: Bare scalp, maintained to near-mirror polish every 4-5 days
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye natural dark brown; right eye: violet-tinted retinal overlay on dark sclera, creating an unnatural luminous quality in dim light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones, displaying the blended warmth of Eastern European, Hispanic/Latin American, and Pacific Islander ancestry. Slightly sallow from indoor laboratory hours but with an underlying richness to the complexion.
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones reflecting Eastern European structure, narrow jaw softened by Latin and Pacific Islander facial geometry. Dark circles under eyes suggest chronic sleep debt. Skin is clear but carries a faint sheen from subcutaneous neural mesh integration sites. The interplay of warm undertones creates subtle dimension across the face. Minimal grooming beyond the shaved head — they do not prioritize appearance.
distinguishing_marks: Constellation of 7-8 bioluminescent dots across left cheekbone in a scattered arc pattern, soft blue-white glow when active or in darkness
Fine linear scar along right temple from retinal overlay surgical integration, barely visible
Faint network of silvered lines visible beneath skin on both wrists where haptic input mesh feeds into forearms
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retinal display overlay (right eye only, violet UI distinctly visible), bioluminescent cheekbone constellation (aesthetic geneware), haptic input panels woven into jacket sleeves (textile-integrated tech with raised nodules across both forearms), subcutaneous neural mesh tracery visible at wrists and neck in high-contrast lighting
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually restless — fingers tap against jacket panels even when standing still. Walks with slightly forward head posture from chronic interface work. Often stops mid-gesture as if catching themselves before finishing a thought. When concentrating, they rock slightly or tap rhythms on their thighs. Eye contact is inconsistent; they look away when thinking, directly at people when experiencing them as problems to solve.
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered tech-wear in muted tones (charcoal, deep grey, black, occasional deep purple). Signature item: a modified jacket with visibly integrated haptic input panels across both sleeves and torso, modular pockets, and reinforced seams for wearable hardware. Underneath: fitted base layers that interface with their neural mesh. No visible branding — clothing is functional, tier 2-3 research facility standard. Occasionally wears a thin tether necklace (non-functional, decorative) made from recycled data ribbon. Footwear: comfortable slip-on interface shoes with subtle haptic feedback. Jewelry: none beyond the bioluminescent cheekbone dots.
